title: Central Station interchange guide
content: Central Station is served by the Blue Line. Surface routes 10 and 20 stop beside the station. A closure may cause riders to consider nearby services, but this record does not measure passenger demand or replacement capacity.

title: Route 10 North-South profile
content: Route 10 connects Central Station with North Market and River Park. It serves the Downtown and Northside districts.

title: Route 20 Crosstown profile
content: Route 20 connects Central Station with West Library and East Hospital. It serves the West End, Downtown and Eastside districts.

title: How to interpret network connections
content: A mapped connection indicates potential network reach. It does not prove that residents were affected, that a rider transferred, or that another service had enough capacity. Those claims require observed demand, travel behaviour and service-capacity evidence.
